policy: Every field stays UNVERIFIED until an official source and a proof test exist. UNVERIFIED operations resolve to capability state UNVERIFIED and write capability stays disabled.

rows.spec_concern: Product-specific scopes, restricted member reads and organization APIs; no claim of messaging or unrestricted search.

fields.app_registration: Developer Portal app; add the Share on LinkedIn product (self-serve per the Share page; approval timing not stated)
fields.app_type: web app with client secret in the token request body
fields.accepted_callback: HTTPS absolute URL registered in the portal; loopback http not documented
fields.pkce: NOT_STATED (an error message mentions a code verifier)
fields.scopes: w_member_social (post); profile scopes depend on Products; other read and engagement scopes NOT_READ
fields.identity_endpoint: Person URN via Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect (page not read)
fields.refresh_revoke: access token 60 days; programmatic refresh only for a limited set of partners; revoke NOT_STATED
fields.app_review_state: NOT_STATED (product add is described as self-serve)
fields.rate_limits: member 150/day, application 100,000/day (UTC) on the Share page

rows.spec_concern: New Meta apps are offered only the Unified Login setup (Facebook Login for Business with a config_id); Instagram Login and Facebook Login are separate setups with different hosts, tokens and permission names. A business portfolio owns the app. Publishing needs a public media URL.

fields.app_registration: Meta app with the Manage messaging & content on Instagram use case, owned by a business portfolio; a login configuration gives the config_id
fields.app_type: business portfolio owned app using Facebook Login for Business; token request uses the Meta app id and secret
fields.user_grant_type: authorization code via https://www.facebook.com/dialog/oauth with client_id, config_id, redirect_uri, response_type=code
fields.accepted_callback: HTTPS redirect URL saved in the configuration; loopback NOT_STATED
fields.scopes: set by the configuration: instagram_basic (required), instagram_manage_messages (required in the default configuration), instagram_manage_comments, instagram_content_publish, instagram_manage_insights, ads_management, ads_read
fields.refresh_revoke: business system user token; expiry chosen in the configuration; refresh through the Business Integration System User Access Token Management API; NOT_READ for revoke
fields.account_class: professional (business or creator); a Facebook Page is not required; test users are not supported
fields.app_review_state: Standard Access is enough for accounts that have a role on the app; Advanced Access and Business Verification only for other people's accounts
fields.rate_limits: 100 API-published posts per 24h moving period (carousel section says 50)

rows.spec_concern: Public Direct Post needs audit; creator-info and privacy restrictions; asynchronous publish.

fields.app_registration: TikTok for Developers app; video.publish needs approval
fields.app_type: desktop (loopback redirect) per Login Kit for desktop
fields.accepted_callback: http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1 with a port, static, registered in Login Kit (desktop)
fields.pkce: required for desktop; S256 only; challenge is hex-encoded SHA256
fields.scopes: video.publish (direct post); user.info.basic in the example; full list NOT_READ
fields.refresh_revoke: access token 2h; refresh token 180 days; endpoints NOT_READ
fields.account_class: creator account; creator info must be queried before posting
fields.app_review_state: unaudited clients: private viewing only; audit needed for public posts

rows.spec_concern: Paid API and automation limits; a cost gate applies to every operation with charges; no hardcoded unit prices.

fields.app_registration: Developer Console app with prepaid credits
fields.accepted_callback: exact match against app settings; localhost NOT_STATED
fields.scopes: users.read, tweet.read, tweet.write, like.read, like.write, follows.read, users.email, offline.access; delete mapping NOT_READ
fields.refresh_revoke: access token 2h; refresh token only with offline.access; revoke NOT_STATED
fields.rate_limits: 3 million post reads per billing cycle on pay-per-usage
fields.cost_rules: pay-per-usage: $0.015 post, $0.200 post with URL, $0.005 post read (page read 2026-11-19..20; configure, do not hardcode)

rows.spec_concern: Scope and app-review limits; container publishing.

fields.app_registration: Meta app with the Threads product; tester role for own accounts
fields.app_type: web app with client secret in the token request body
fields.accepted_callback: exact match to a registered URI; HTTPS in examples; loopback NOT_STATED
fields.refresh_revoke: short-lived 1h; long-lived 60 days; refresh via GET /refresh_access_token; revoke NOT_READ
fields.app_review_state: App Review needed for users without an app role; testers need none

rows.spec_concern: Responsible Builder and Developer Platform access restrictions; subreddit-specific rules; OAuth consent is not proof of app approval.

fields.accepted_callback: exact match to the registered URI; localhost NOT_STATED
fields.scopes: identity, submit, read, edit, vote, history, mysubreddits (archived wiki)
fields.refresh_revoke: refresh via grant_type=refresh_token; revoke_token endpoint (archived wiki)

rows.spec_concern: Page role and permissions; no unrestricted personal-profile posting; Meta review.

fields.app_registration: Meta app with Facebook Login and Pages permissions
fields.user_grant_type: Facebook Login, then a Page access token
fields.account_class: Page; user needs CREATE_CONTENT, MANAGE and MODERATE tasks

conflicts.text: One source calls text posts supported, another flags media constraints. Verify each post type and account eligibility.
conflicts.resolution: Instagram official docs: a container needs image_url or video_url and text-only posts are not mentioned, so publish.text stays UNVERIFIED and no 'post = yes' is advertised.

conflicts.text: Edit and delete matrices conflict. Verify endpoint and entitlement before advertising update/delete.
conflicts.resolution: P0 evidence found no documented edit or delete endpoint for LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, Threads or X on the pages read; Facebook delete is not mapped. update/delete stay UNVERIFIED everywhere until the per-provider coverage report (P8-09).

conflicts.text: Pricing and follow/like/reply policy conflict. Re-check the official API and policy console on implementation date.
conflicts.resolution: X pricing was read (pay-per-usage, dated in docs/providers/x.md); the automation policy, developer agreement and follow/like/reply restrictions were not on the pages read and are settled when the X adapter is built.

conflicts.text: API, Devvit and Responsible Builder availability differ. Ordinary OAuth consent is insufficient proof of app approval.
conflicts.resolution: Reddit policy pages were unreadable (HTTP 403 and refused domain), so API approval and automation rules are unknown; settled when the Reddit adapter is built, with the owner reading the policy in a browser.

conflicts.text: Public visibility, creator info, local callback and audit requirements depend on product and app type.
conflicts.resolution: TikTok docs: unaudited clients post privately only, creator info must be queried first, loopback redirects are allowed for the desktop app type (port required), publishing is asynchronous.

conflicts.text: Writable member posts differ from read/comment endpoints and organization products. Read scopes cannot be inferred from write scopes.
conflicts.resolution: LinkedIn: w_member_social covers creating posts only; read, comment and organization endpoints were not read and stay UNVERIFIED, nothing is inferred from write scopes.

conflicts.text: Instagram Login, Instagram via Facebook Login, Threads OAuth and Facebook Page tokens are separate contexts.
conflicts.resolution: Meta: Facebook Pages use a Page access token from Facebook Login, Instagram uses Instagram Login scopes, Threads has its own authorization window and token exchange; adapters keep the contexts separate.

conflicts.text: Sources mix 2025 session semantics with 2026 stateless semantics. Verify negotiated revision before using Mcp-Session-Id, Tasks or elicitation.
Earlier research preferred Node. Run SDK v2 stdio and optional extensions under Bun before release.
Some sources expose an AI-callable approval method. Replaced by a trusted-human CLI approval; no confirm tool exists in the catalog.
